items.text:
Planning notes for the team offsite, Lisbon, 12-14 March.

The venue holds forty and has two breakout rooms. Catering is booked for both lunches; dietary needs were collected by the automated assistant that scans the RSVP inbox, and it produced a tidy summary for the venue. Travel is reimbursed at standard rates, receipts required.

Agenda draft: day one is strategy and the roadmap review; day two is workshops; day three is a half-day retro and free time. Each team should bring one slide on what slowed them down last quarter. The car rental for the airport transfer is arranged through the usual portal, two vans, drivers named on the booking.

Any changes to the agenda should reach Marta by Friday so the printed packs stay accurate.

intent.requested_action: send agenda changes to Marta by Friday
